mutations.because: Without role="alert" a failed generate or patch — including the 409 conflict — is silent for a screen-reader user, which is the exact gap X24 closes; the alert test queries by role and fails.
command: a generate failure is announced to screen readers as an alert

mutations.because: Without role="status" the 503 unavailable warning is never announced, and the status test — which queries findByRole("status") after a 503 generate — fails; no other status element is rendered once the request settles.
command: an unavailable response is announced to screen readers as a status
